claude.request:
Today's international headlines:
- What we know so far after Krakow gun attack: Six people were killed in a random shooting in the city's main square, and three bodies were later found at the home of the attacker.
- Israel's president tasks opposition leader Eisenkot with forming government: Neither PM Benjamin Netanyahu's bloc nor that of his rival secured a majority in last week's election.
- No clear winner after tight New Zealand general election: Weeks of coalition talks could follow after preliminary results pointed to a highly divided national parliament.
- US offers $20m reward for information about Iran's nuclear programme: Donald Trump has repeatedly raised the prospect of renewing strikes against Iran's nuclear facilities.
- Houthis say at least 33 killed in Saudi air strike: Saudi Arabia, which leads a coalition fighting the Houthis in Yemen, has not commented.
- UK cannot 'cherry pick' EU single market deal, Barnier tells BBC: The former Brexit negotiator says EU countries would reject any British attempts to follow economic rules "a la carte".
- With Stephen Miller pick, Trump readies for a battle: The US president's promotion of Miller, a loyal partisan firebrand to be his new chief of staff sets up likely clashes with Congress.
- Pope in 'pretty good health' as he starts Latin America tour: Pope Leo travels to Uruguay just three weeks after having surgery for lung cancer.
- Italian foreign minister says hackers leaked his personal data: Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni has blamed pro-Russian hackers for publishing the details online.
- Russian strikes wound nine and damage Ukraine's power network ahead of talks: The attacks come before Ukrainian and Russian delegations are due to take part in trilateral talks in Abu Dhabi next week.
- Meghan's father Thomas Markle under house arrest after child sex abuse material charge: The 82-year-old appeared in court in Florida after the FBI searched two Los Angeles-area storage units he rented.
- Texas mayor instructs police to limit co-operation with ICE: There has been months of public outcry in Houston after an Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) officer fatally shot a man who was driving to work.
